evidence: The plan specifies "Frame Rate: 60 fps" instead of the required 30fps, and text overlays are only placed qualitatively (e.g. "appears bottom-left at 1.3s", "appears bottom-right", "appears center") with no x/y coordinates or pixel bounds tying them to the safe zone (top ≥ 250px, bottom ≤ 1500px, right ≤ 960px).
